# posst.app

> AI-powered social media posting for small businesses. Automated daily posts to Facebook and Instagram — zero effort from you.

## What posst.app does

posst.app is a fully automated social media posting service for small businesses. Three AI agents — a Social Agent, a Branding Agent, and a Scheduling Agent — work together to create and publish original social media posts to your Facebook Page and Instagram account every single day.

Businesses sign up, connect their Facebook Page via a secure OAuth flow, and the AI agents take over. Captions are written in the business's own tone using its description, location, and a rotating daily content theme. Images are AI-generated (Standard plan) or pulled from the business's own Google Drive photos (Pro plan).

## Plans and Pricing

- Standard: A$24.99/month — AI-generated images and captions, daily posts to Facebook and Instagram.
- Pro: A$34.99/month — Everything in Standard, plus your own photos from Google Drive and custom daily content themes.
- 30-day free trial on both plans. No charge until Day 30.

## Platforms supported

- Facebook Pages
- Instagram Business accounts
- Google Business Profile — coming soon
